nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.title: NoFireWorkFly Config
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.enableNo: When disabled, elytra behaves like vanilla and all enhancements are turned off
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.armorSlo: Whether armor slows elytra flight speed
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.canSlowF: Press sneak while flying to stop and apply slow falling
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.maxSlowe: Maximum speed reduction from armor at full armor points (1.0 - 10.0)
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.consumeD: Whether elytra loses durability during flight, false = unbreakable
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.required: Minimum food level required to fly (0.0 - 20.0)
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.maxHeigh: Whether to enforce a maximum flight height
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.dropOutO: Stop flying when food runs out
nofireworkfly_neo.configuration.maxHeigh: Maximum height above world limit for flight (16 - 384)
